title: Too heavy
text: Too heavy. This blanket, while well made, is too heavy. As an occupational therapist, in my view, companies are going too heavy and leaning too far into the 10-15% of the body weight. Really heavy only feels good for a bit, you want a constant low grade weight for good sleep. The companies are also loosing out by not customizing these, but ... my advise is do not buy a super heavy blanket and if you have breathing and heart disorders avoid them!

product_metadata.title: YnM Kids Exclusive Weighted Blanket, Soothing, Smallest Compartments with Glass Beads, Bed Blanket for One Person of 90lbs, Ideal for Twin Bed (41x60 Inches, 10 Pounds, Dark Grey)
features: YNM EXCLUSIVE UPDATED VERSION: 2”x2” smallest compartments

[Innovative Design] The 7-layer system design adapts to the curve of your body for optimal comfort and the 2x2-inch smallest sections allow for more equitable weight distribution. It includes more glass beads and less fiberfill for enhanced temperature regulation. In addition, a three-dimensional lock bead stitching method prevents leaking of beads. It has the finest stitching (0.25mm per stitch) to avoid movement of weight between compartments. All of these attributes make it a superb blanket.

[Unique Sleeping Experience] YnM provides a natural means of calming the body for a good night's sleep. It is a wonderful sensory blanket for adults and children to help them relax and feel at ease. Great gifts for your loved ones.
[Sizing Guide] To get the appropriate size for one adult, take 10% of your body weight and add 1 pound. Please select a weighted blanket measuring 80x87 inches or 88x104 inches for sharing.

[Duvet Cover]: Breathable cotton/linen duvet cover, cooling bamboo duvet cover or cozy minky duvet cover are available in YnM. From YnM you can find a perfect duvet for you and for protection of your weighted blanket
[Loops] It has 16 sturdy loops for securing the duvet cover (available separately) to prevent slippage.

[Easy Care] Machine washable in a gentle setting. Tumble dry on a low setting or line dry. Use a mild detergent and avoid bleach. If you use YnM weighted blanket with a duvet cover, then you can just wash the light weight duvet cover instead of washing the heavy inner weighted blanket.

[Reminder] Weighted blankets are not meant to hang off the edge of your bed. This concentrates weight into the areas where it is needed most. On you! So a weighted blanket is much smaller than an ordinary blanket.
